title: Delhi - building plan sanction (seed)
citation: Unified Building Bye-Laws for Delhi 2016, read with MPD-2021
verify: Delhi plots are sanctioned by different bodies (MCD, NDMC, DDA, the cantonment board) depending on where they fall, and residential plots up to the notified size follow a self-certified route rather than a full scrutiny. Confirm the route and the body before submitting. Every field below is a seed.

sheets.note: Site / key plan locating the plot in its block and colony.
One plan per storey, including stilt and terrace where present.
Section through the stair, showing every floor-to-floor height.
FAR, ground coverage, setbacks and height against the plot-size band.

statutoryFields.label: BLOCK / COLONY
statutoryFields.note: Block and colony, which is how a Delhi plot is addressed on a sanction.

statutoryFields.label: ARCH. REG. NO.
statutoryFields.note: Council of Architecture registration - the self-certification route turns on it.

statutoryFields.label: OWNER
statutoryFields.note: Owner as registered, for the signature block.

declarations: The plan conforms to the Unified Building Bye-Laws for Delhi 2016 and to the National Building Code 2016 as applicable.
All dimensions are in millimetres unless noted otherwise. Do not scale off this drawing.
